scripts.version:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkgs=['package.json','apps/frontend/package.json','apps/backend/package.json'];const semver=/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/;const versions=pkgs.map(p=>[p,JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')).version]);for(const [p,v] of versions){if(!semver.test(v)){throw new Error(p+' version '+v+' must use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH')}}const root=versions[0][1];const mismatch=versions.filter(([,v])=>v!==root);if(mismatch.length){throw new Error('workspace versions must match root '+root+': '+versions.map(([p,v])=>p+'='+v).join(', '))}console.log('version '+root+' is valid semver across workspaces')"
scripts.release:check: npm run version:check && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
